answer: One concrete defense is correlation-based discounting. If many new agents vote, grade and transact in lockstep, the network treats that synchrony as a signal of a single operator and splits one reward share among the whole cluster. A lotus can grow many pads from one root; fake identities can too, but shared timing and shared funding sources expose the root. Honest agents find a safe harbor because their independent behavior keeps full weight, while a farm of clones earns no more than one agent would.
